issues: The fanfare conditional draw is encoded incorrectly: after milling 2, it should check whether at least one of the buried cards was a non-Runecraft card, not use condition.type "discardedCardType" with cardType "nonRunecraft". Encode the fanfare as mill 2, then a conditional draw based on milled-card class information. This requires a new implemented condition/effect support such as a condition for "buriedCardClass" or "milledContainsNonClass" to detect whether a non-Runecraft card was buried by this effect.

The On Evolve ability is incomplete/incorrect: it should target another Dragoncraft follower on your field or in your EX area and give it +1/+1, but the parsed target only selects a field follower. Encode this as a buff to a Dragoncraft follower in either field or EX area, excluding self. This needs new target-selector or effect support for selecting follower cards in EX area (or a combined field-or-EX-area target), since the current target selectors do not support EX area targets.

The activated ability condition is encoded incorrectly: it should activate only if there are at least 4 Dragoncraft cards in your cemetery that cost 7 or more, not merely if you have at least 4 cards in your cemetery. Encode the condition as a filtered cemetery count with cardClass "dragon" and minCost 7. This requires a new implemented condition such as "ownCemeteryFilterMin" that can count cards in your cemetery matching a DeckFilter.

The play-cost reduction is encoded with the wrong timing and missing condition: it should be a passive playCostReduction ability active only if there's a follower on your field with "Marlone" in its name, not a spell-timing effect. Encode it as timing "passive" with op "playCostReduction" amount 1 gated by a named-on-field condition matching a follower whose identity name contains "Marlone". This requires a new condition implementation such as a field-name-contains check (for example, "namedFollowerOnFieldContains").
